d: Bihar Employees : bihar ke karib 9.5 lakh sarkari karmachariyon aur lagbhag 3 lakh penshnars ke lie bari khabar samne aa rahi hai... rajy sarkar mahangaee bhatte (DA) men 3 phisdi barhotri ki taiyari kar rahi hai... prastav ke mutabik, maujuda 60 phisdi DA ko barhakar 63 phisdi kiya ja sakta hai... agar prastav ko manjuri milti hai to naee dar 1 julaee 2026 se lagu ho sakti hai... karmachariyon ko julaee se aktubar tak char mahine ka eriyar milne ki bhi sanbhavna hai... anuman ke mutabik, mul vetan ke aadhar par har mahine 540 rupye se lekar 7,500 rupye tak ka atirikt phayda ho sakta hai
